def factor_dryup_depth_range_tightness_5_60_volume(df):
    '''Idea: Volume dry-up inside a compressed price range signals absorption and delayed expansion/breakout.
    Logic: Shortfall of 5-day average volume vs 60-day average measures participation shrinkage; 1 minus the ratio of 10-day to 60-day close range measures price consolidation. Their product is high when volume is unusually dry and price is unusually tight.
    Sub-mechanism tags: volume_dry_up, range_compression, absorption_capacity.
    Formula: dry = 1 - SMA(vol,5)/SMA(vol,60); tight = 1 - Rng(close,10)/Rng(close,60); signal = dry * tight.'''
    df_copy = df.copy()
    vol_ma5 = df_copy['volume'].rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_ma60 = df_copy['volume'].rolling(60, min_periods=60).mean()
    dry_up = 1.0 - vol_ma5 / vol_ma60.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    high10 = df_copy['close'].rolling(10, min_periods=10).max()
    low10 = df_copy['close'].rolling(10, min_periods=10).min()
    high60 = df_copy['close'].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max()
    low60 = df_copy['close'].rolling(60, min_periods=60).min()
    tightness = 1.0 - (high10 - low10) / (high60 - low60).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    signal = dry_up * tightness
    return signal.rename('factor_dryup_depth_range_tightness_5_60_volume')
